name: Chief Minister’s UPSC Combined Civil Services Coaching Scheme
briefDescription: The Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh started this scheme to promote local APST candidates to compete in National Competitive Examinations conducted by UPSC.
descriptionMd: The Chief Minister’s UPSC Combined Civil Services Coaching Scheme, launched by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh, aims to support local Arunachal Pradesh Schedule Tribe (APST) candidates. The primary objective is to enhance their competitiveness in national examinations conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC).
benefitsMd:
- Access to coaching for UPSC Civil Services Examinations.
- Support to compete in national competitive exams.
eligibilityMd:
- Must be a local Arunachal Pradesh Schedule Tribe (APST) candidate.
- Aspiring to compete in National Competitive Examination conducted by the UPSC.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
